name: Don Bacon
stance: Wants AI development closely monitored with guardrails if warranted, but warns that regulating AI now would cost the US the race with China.

statements.text: Praised University of Nebraska Omaha NCITE researchers for demonstrating on Capitol Hill how terrorists can exploit jailbroken AI.
At the same time, we should closely monitor AI development & be prepared to put in guardrails if warranted. But, over regulating AI now is a recipe for defeat.
